_meta.description: Modelled products for the demo. Figures are representative of publicly advertised structures; exact terms change, so each product names its data date. The cost engine computes the markup/APR from these inputs; no figure is asserted without its inputs shown.
_meta.note: amounts in KES. principal = value received today (cash received, or cash price of the asset).
